title: Benchmarking Automatic Speech Recognition Tools for Iberian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of automatic speech recognition models across different languages, specifically contrasting high-resource languages (e.g., Spanish, German) with low-resource languages (e.g., Basque, Catalan).
Disaggregating speech recognition performance by speaker sex metadata to compare the Word Error Rate (WER) between male and female speakers across various models.
